description: This Java class defines the 'Content' entity used to model content items within an e-commerce platform. It includes attributes such as id, descriptions, merchant store association, visibility, content position, type, and sorting order. It leverages JPA annotations for ORM mapping, Hibernate Validator for validation, and extends a generic entity class for common entity properties.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Entity class representing content items with metadata such as descriptions, merchant association, visibility, and content grouping attributes. Implements Serializable and extends a generic entity class for standard id handling.
